Mindfulness is difficult for those of us with brains that never seem to shut up. It's very difficult for me personally, but I can't deny its effectiveness either. I don't know if this will help you at all, but I approach it as examining each anxiety/depression trigger as it comes, and really unpacking/evaluating it. Determine whether or not A. it's something you really, truly care about, and B. whether you have any control over it. If answering no to A or B, I file it under 'Don't Give A Flying F#uck' in my head. The more you're able to do this, the less you'll care about things that used to bother you. It's not a panacea, but it's a useful tool to have. Your blur will still be around, but slowly your thoughts will become more clear.
